title: NBA Daily Digest
subtitle: October 28, 2026: Unbeaten Blazers, Tatum's Buzzer-Beater Highlight Action-Packed Night

items.headline: Blazers Remain Undefeated, Tatum Sinks Nets at the Buzzer in OT Thriller
items.summary: The Portland Trail Blazers extended their perfect start to 3-0 with a hard-fought 136-129 victory over the Lakers, while Jayson Tatum's 40-point masterpiece culminated in an overtime buzzer-beater, securing a 125-124 win for the Celtics against the Nets.

items.headline: Trail Blazers Outlast Lakers in High-Scoring Affair
items.summary: The Portland Trail Blazers moved to 3-0 on the season, defeating the Los Angeles Lakers 136-129. Ja Morant and Deni Avdija each contributed 23 points, with Damian Lillard adding 21, including a crucial late 3-pointer. Luka Doncic led the Lakers with 41 points and 9 assists in their first loss of the season.

items.headline: Tatum's 40-Point Heroics Lead Celtics Past Nets in Overtime
items.summary: Jayson Tatum delivered a phenomenal 40-point performance, capped by a 17-foot jumper at the overtime buzzer, to give the Boston Celtics a 125-124 victory over the Brooklyn Nets. Michael Porter Jr. had 27 points and 12 rebounds for the Nets, who fell to 0-4.

items.headline: Jayson Tatum's Game-Winner Caps 40-Point Night
items.summary: Celtics star Jayson Tatum poured in 40 points, hitting 10-of-20 from the field and an impressive 18-of-22 from the free-throw line, including the decisive overtime buzzer-beater against the Nets.

items.headline: Luka Doncic Drops 41 Points, 9 Assists
items.summary: Despite the Lakers' loss to the Blazers, Luka Doncic showcased his scoring prowess with 41 points and 9 assists, marking his 10th 50-point plus performance in less than two years with the Lakers this past weekend, following a 52 point game against Utah.

items.headline: Morant, Avdija, Lillard Fuel Blazers' Unbeaten Start
items.summary: The Portland Trail Blazers were propelled by balanced scoring from Ja Morant (23 pts), Deni Avdija (23 pts), and Damian Lillard (21 pts), combining for 67 points in their victory over the Lakers.

items.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo Era Off to Rocky Start in Miami
items.summary: The Miami Heat are currently one of four winless teams, sitting at 0-4 to begin the 2026-27 NBA season, despite acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo this summer. They look to secure their first victory today against the Atlanta Hawks.

items.headline: Tonight's NBA Schedule: Lakers vs. Clippers, Rockets vs. Bucks
items.summary: Tonight's action includes an exciting inter-city rivalry as the Los Angeles Lakers face the Los Angeles Clippers, while the Houston Rockets travel to take on the Milwaukee Bucks. The Miami Heat will also be searching for their first win against the Atlanta Hawks.
